<section class="hm-sec hm-about">
  <div class="hm-sec-h"><span class="e">About</span><a href="/cv-and-short-bio/">Full CV and bio &rarr;</a></div>
  <p>Justin S. Eloriaga is an Economist at the International Monetary Fund&#x27;s Shanghai
  Center (国际货币基金组织上海中心), the Fund&#x27;s regional hub for the Asia-Pacific. His
  research is in macroeconomics, with a focus on Bayesian time-series econometrics and
  monetary economics.</p>
  <p>He holds a Ph.D. in Economics from Emory University, completed under the auspices of the
  J. William Fulbright Scholarship, and is an Associate Editor at the <em>DLSU Business &amp;
  Economics Review</em>. Before joining the Fund he taught at Emory and at De La Salle
  University, and was a Central Bank Associate at the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas.</p>
</section>
